Name: KEY_ASSIGN_DISPLAY_PARAM
Description: Determines the parameters relating the display of key assignments.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: With a Key set: text ID of the item name and its one-line help. Without a Key: text ID of the category name.

Fields.Name: Key
Fields.Description: The user input key to be assigned. If not specified, it will be treated as a category display item.

Fields.Name: Allow Unassignment
Fields.Description: If ON, then this key can be unassigned.

Fields.Name: Allow Pad Configuration
Fields.Description: If ON, the controller assignment of this key can be changed.

Fields.Name: Allow Mouse Configuration
Fields.Description: If ON, the mouse assignment of this key can be changed.

Fields.Name: Key Group
Fields.Description: Group used to detect duplicate assignments. Keys in the same group cannot share an input.

Fields.Name: Mapping Text ID
Fields.Description: The item name to display in the operation list. 0 means it is not displayed.

Fields.Name: Display in Configuration Menu
Fields.Description: If ON, then this key is displayed in the key configuration menu.
